problem.description: Form fields in UserModal are not accessible for editing when trying to edit a user

finding.details: UserModal uses error={errors.field_name} but Input component expects hasError boolean prop. This might be causing the fields to appear disabled or have unexpected behavior.

finding.issue: No explicit disabled/readonly logic for form fields
finding.details: All input fields are editable by default, no disabled or readonly props are set. The login field (username) should be readonly when editing existing users.

requirements.requirement: Enable editing for user_name (Имя пользователя) field
Make username (Логин) field read-only when editing existing user

solution.step: Fix Input component prop usage - change error to hasError
Add readonly prop to username field when in editing mode
Ensure user_name and user_email fields remain editable
